definition.method: Run numeric simulation with reduced coupling variance (0.15) to test sensitivity of value divergence.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [4003, 4004])
    random.seed(seeds[0])
    coupling_variance = params.get('coupling_variance', 0.15)
    # Simulating divergent path evolution
    v1 = random.random() * (1.0 + coupling_variance)
    v2 = random.random() * (1.0 - coupling_variance)
    variance_delta = abs(v1 - v2)
    return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [variance_delta]}}
definition.stop: After successful execution of the defined parameter range.
